sections.A: Pet ke upar ya seene ki bari surgery ke baad anaesthesia, dard aur dawaon se saans chhoti ho jati hai aur phephron ke masle (PPCs) ho sakte hain.
sections.B: Surgery ki qism aur zakhm, dard ki dawa, drains aur lines, aur surgery se pehle ki halat dekhein.
sections.D: Vital signs, oxygen, dard ka score, seene ki aawaz aur zakhm ko sahara de kar khansi.
sections.G: Achanak saans phoolna, seene ka dard aur tez dhadkan (PE), ya barhti saans, bukhar aur nayi aawazein (infection): medical team.
sections.H: Surgery se pehle saans ki exercises, sahara de kar khansi aur jaldi chalne ki education. Baad mein jaldi uthna aur chalna.
sections.I: Jaldi mobilisation (lines aur drains sambhal kar), gehri saans ki exercises aur zakhm ko sahara de kar khansi.
sections.M: SpO2, oxygen ki zaroorat, seene ki aawaz, bukhar, chalne ka faasla aur dard se ruki saans dobara dekhein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Pet ke upar wali surgery mein dard aur diaphragm ki kamzori phephron ka hajam kam karti hain.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
